episode_title: Exploring Brand Intimacy and Digital Design with Sidney Blank from MBLM Agency

real_qa.q: What is the Brand Intimacy Quotient and how does MBLM Agency measure brand relationships?
real_qa.r: MBLM developed a measurement model by scraping social media data across YouTube, Reddit, X, Facebook and other platforms, running a large language model over original posts to score relationships based on sentiment and verbal cues. They analyze 450 brands across archetypes like nostalgia, performance, and indulgence, then publish the data to a web interface where users can see brand rankings, segment by industry, drill into specific brands, and compare brands head-to-head. The Brand Intimacy Quotient aims to compete against benchmarks like Net Promoter Score.

real_qa.q: What are the stages of brand relationship in MBLM's brand intimacy framework?
real_qa.r: MBLM identifies three stages of brand relationship similar to personal relationships: Sharing, where you begin to get to know a brand and feel affinity for it; Bonding, after you've used it for some time and had positive experiences; and Fusing, when you're a true fan or advocate. The goal is to move people through these phases and keep them in close proximity, though brands can also experience a fall from grace, as demonstrated by Tesla when perceptions shifted around its leadership.
real_qa.requete: brand intimacy stages Sharing Bonding Fusing

real_qa.q: How does MBLM distinguish between commoditized UI/UX design and quality custom design?
real_qa.r: Sidney Blank explains that the difference lies in whether a design is created specifically for a particular company and experience versus using frameworks and templates. Custom-designed interactive experiences feel more authentic, ownable, and resonate more deeply, similar to how professionally photographed imagery differs from stock photography. Involving the organization throughout the design process creates a sense of pride in the result and produces better outcomes because stakeholders care more deeply about the work.
real_qa.requete: commoditized UI UX design versus custom design

real_qa.q: What major brand redesign projects has MBLM Agency completed for digital implementation?
real_qa.r: MBLM collaborated as part of a consortium of agencies on the American Airlines brand rollout for digital, which Sidney Blank notes remains present in airports years later at check-in gates. This was a proud moment for him to show his work to his family.
real_qa.requete: American Airlines brand redesign MBLM digital

real_qa.q: Where are MBLM Agency's office locations and how does the firm organize its integrated services?
real_qa.r: MBLM is headquartered in New York City with a strong presence in Dubai and an office in Seoul opened a few years ago; the firm previously had a presence in Mexico City as well. As an integrated firm, MBLM offers brand strategy and positioning, verbal and visual identity development, and campaign executions—though they do not provide PR services—to create a seamless brand presence for clients.
real_qa.requete: MBLM Agency offices locations New York Dubai Seoul

guest.bio_context: Sidney Blank studied architecture in Germany, earning a master's degree, and moved to New York where he taught digital media at Pratt Institute in the early 2000s. He transitioned from architecture to communications and marketing, eventually joining MBLM (Emblem) as head of digital, where he has been for the last 15 years. His expertise spans digital design, brand strategy, and the creation of customized digital experiences.
